models.associations: Community organizations like diaspora associations, cultural clubs, or savings groups. Each association has its own branding, settings, and members.
models.members: People who belong to an association, each with a specific role (president, treasurer, secretary, admin, or member) and membership status.
models.announcements: Important messages posted by association admins to all members, with different priority levels.
models.activityItems: Recent events within an association, like new members joining, circles being created, or announcements being posted.
models.pendingInvitations: Invitations sent to potential members that haven't been accepted yet.
models.joinRequests: Requests from users who want to join a private or invite-only association, awaiting approval.
models.migrationSession: A migration session tracks the entire import process for one association, including which phase the organizer is on, overall progress, and go-live scheduling.
models.importedAssociation: The association being imported with its identity, governance structure, privacy settings, and communication preferences.
models.importedMembers: Member records parsed from a spreadsheet or added manually, with validation status, role assignment, and invitation tracking.
models.importedCircles: ROSCA circle configurations imported with parameters, mid-cycle state, payout order, and financial summaries.
models.validationReport: Pre-go-live validation results covering association config, members, circles, and permissions.
models.memberVerifications: Records of imported members reviewing and confirming (or disputing) their imported data.

relationships: Each Association has many Members (through Membership)
Each Association has many Activity Items tracking recent events
Pending Invitations belong to an Association and track who was invited
Join Requests belong to an Association and track who wants to join
Each MigrationSession contains one ImportedAssociation being migrated
Each MigrationSession contains multiple ImportedMembers and ImportedCircles
Each ImportedCircle has PaymentMatrix entries for mid-cycle state
MemberVerifications link ImportedMembers to their self-verification status

federationPolicies.title: Financial Transparency Standards
federationPolicies.content: All member associations must maintain transparent financial records and submit quarterly reports to the federation. Annual audits are required for associations with more than CHF 50,000 in annual transactions.

federationPolicies.title: Member Code of Conduct
federationPolicies.content: All members of federation associations agree to uphold principles of mutual respect, cultural sensitivity, and community solidarity. Violations may result in suspension from savings circles and association events.

federationPolicies.title: Data Privacy Guidelines
federationPolicies.content: Member associations must comply with Swiss data protection laws and GDPR. Personal data may only be shared within the federation for legitimate purposes with member consent.

federationAnnouncements.title: Federation Annual Conference 2026
federationAnnouncements.content: Save the date! Our annual conference will be held in Geneva on March 20-22, 2026. This year's theme is 'Building Bridges: Cross-Cultural Collaboration in the Digital Age'. Registration opens February 1st.

federationAnnouncements.title: New Policy: Emergency Fund Interoperability
federationAnnouncements.content: Starting February 2026, member associations can request emergency fund support from the federation when local funds are insufficient. Applications will be reviewed within 48 hours.
